items.title: After 472 days, Tyrese Haliburton makes emotional return in Pacers’ preseason opener
items.body_excerpt: Hilton Coliseum was filled with Iowa State fans supporting Tyrese Haliburton & the Pacers. (Photo: CycloneMBB) Tyrese Haliburton waited 472 days for this moment. In that time between games played, he watched the Pacers go from Game 7 of the NBA Finals to the worst record in…
